title: Moov Transfer
description: Schema for a Moov money movement transfer between two accounts. Transfers move funds via ACH, RTP, or card rails and have a source payment method and a destination payment method. The transfer progresses through a lifecycle from created to completed or failed.

transferID.description: Unique identifier for the transfer assigned by Moov.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the transfer.

source.description: The payment method and account from which funds are debited.

destination.description: The payment method and account to which funds are credited.

description.description: Human-readable description of the transfer purpose.

metadata.description: Custom key-value pairs for application-specific data attached to the transfer.

facilitatorFee.description: Optional fee amount collected by the platform facilitator on this transfer.

moovFee.description: Moov platform fee in cents charged for processing the transfer.

moovFeeDecimal.description: Moov platform fee expressed as a decimal string for high-precision representation.

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the transfer was created.

updatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the transfer was last updated.

completedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the transfer reached a terminal status.

Amount.description: A monetary amount with ISO 4217 currency denomination.

value.description: Amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD). Must be a non-negative integer.

TransferParticipant.description: One side of a transfer, representing the payment method and account involved.

paymentMethodID.description: Unique identifier of the payment method used for this side of the transfer.

paymentMethodType.description: The type of payment instrument used.

account.description: Reference to the Moov account on this side of the transfer.

bankAccount.description: Bank account details when the payment method type is an ACH rail.

wallet.description: Wallet details when the payment method type is moov-wallet.

card.description: Card details when the payment method type is card-payment.

AccountRef.description: A lightweight reference to a Moov account.

accountID.description: Unique identifier for the Moov account.

email.description: Email address of the account holder.

BankAccountRef.description: Summary of a linked bank account involved in a transfer.

bankAccountID.description: Unique identifier for the bank account.

lastFourAccountNumber.description: Last four digits of the bank account number for identification.

routingNumber.description: ABA routing transit number for the bank.

WalletRef.description: Reference to a Moov digital wallet involved in a transfer.

CardRef.description: Summary of a linked card involved in a transfer.

lastFourCardNumber.description: Last four digits of the card number.

Refund.description: A refund issued against a completed card transfer, returning funds to the original payment method.

status.description: Current processing status of the refund.

amount.description: Amount being refunded. Must not exceed the original transfer amount.

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the refund was initiated.

updatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the refund was last updated.

TransferCancellation.description: A cancellation request for a pending transfer that has not yet been submitted to the payment rail.

cancellationID.description: Unique identifier for the cancellation request.

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the cancellation was requested.
